column1: # The compiler domain: the lowering layer's own diagnostics, and the compile driver's messages.
# 251 legacy rows became 217 here, and the difference is the finding: 30 messages were carried TWICE,
# once with an English key and once with a Chinese key (the two migration batches), and nothing compared
# the pair — an edit to one left the other saying something else. They are one row now, and both legacy
# rows are deleted. Four more rows had no call site at all and are deleted rather than migrated: two
# ("compiling %q (bitwise operators) ...") describe a limitation the compiler no longer has, and two
# ("%s:%d: #else without a matching #if") are the pinned module's message spelled out by hand.
# id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
# owner  "local": this repository owns the text
# ctx    where the message is raised, for the translator
# note   what kind of message it is, for the translator
# src    the text this repository ships; for a local id the generator requires it to repeat en
